forbidden.name: runtime-to-runtime
forbidden.comment: src/router/ and src/pi/ never import each other, types included. Put what both need in src/shared/, and reach the router from pi through src/pi/client/router.ts.

forbidden.name: shared-imports
forbidden.comment: A src/shared/ file holds contract schemas and imports only Schema from effect. Move logic into the runtime folder that runs it.

forbidden.name: router-entry-imports
forbidden.comment: src/router/main.ts imports src/router/, src/shared/, effect, the two platform packages, and node:http for createServer, which NodeHttpServer.layer takes.

forbidden.name: pi-entry-imports
forbidden.comment: src/pi/index.ts imports src/pi/, src/shared/, effect, the two platform packages and pi's types.

forbidden.name: feature-imports
forbidden.comment: A feature imports its own files, another feature's index.ts, client/, primitives/, src/shared/ and effect. Export what another feature needs from index.ts, and reach an outside system through a client/ file.

forbidden.name: cli-writes-through-the-router
forbidden.comment: A command never imports the verdict store or the lease registry, so it cannot write them. Only the router writes them; a command asks the running router through client/session-request.ts or client/lease-request.ts (ADRs 0005 and 0007).

forbidden.name: policy-imports
forbidden.comment: The policy imports its own files and effect, nothing else. Hand it a Piece from features/verdicts/ and keep every call out of it.

forbidden.name: client-imports
forbidden.comment: A client/ file imports other client/ files, primitives/, src/shared/ and effect. Call client/ from a feature, never a feature from client/.

forbidden.name: primitives-imports
forbidden.comment: primitives/ knows no feature and no client, and imports only its own files and effect. Move code that needs more into that feature or client/ file.

forbidden.name: production-imports-test
forbidden.comment: Production code never imports a test. Move what both need into a file beside them.

forbidden.name: vitest-in-tests
forbidden.comment: Only a test imports @effect/vitest.

forbidden.name: http-owner
forbidden.comment: HTTP belongs to src/router/client/. Features call its functions, and pi reaches the router through src/pi/client/router.ts.

forbidden.name: process-owner
forbidden.comment: Processes belong to src/router/client/, and in pi to src/pi/client/router.ts. Call their functions.

forbidden.name: disk-owner
forbidden.comment: Disk belongs to src/router/client/. Call the client/ file that owns the value. pi asks the router through src/pi/client/router.ts.

forbidden.name: config-writer
forbidden.comment: Only the CLI writes config.json. Run phi-router accounts add, whose command lives in src/router/features/cli/.

forbidden.name: runtime-owner
forbidden.comment: Return the Effect. The entry file, src/router/main.ts or src/pi/index.ts, runs it.

forbidden.name: platform-owner
forbidden.comment: Depend on the service from effect. The entry file, src/router/main.ts or src/pi/index.ts, provides the platform layer.

forbidden.name: builtins
forbidden.comment: Use the Effect service. FileSystem, Path, ChildProcess, Stdio, or Digest from effect/crypto.

forbidden.name: entry-builtins
forbidden.comment: Use the Effect service. src/router/main.ts imports one builtin, node:http, because NodeHttpServer.layer takes Node's createServer and only the entry file may provide a platform layer.

forbidden.name: vendor-sdk
forbidden.comment: Decode the wire with Schema in a router codec feature. No vendor SDK enters this repository.

forbidden.name: package-reexport
forbidden.comment: Export this file's own functions, never a package's API. A re-export hands an owner's API to the files the map keeps it from.

forbidden.name: tools-imports
forbidden.comment: tools/ imports the router only through a feature's index.ts, client/ and primitives/.

forbidden.name: pi-types
forbidden.comment: Only src/pi/ sees pi types. The router reads the wire through a codec.

required.name: unmapped-source
required.comment: This file fits no row of the layout map in docs/adr/0003. A file under src/ is a .ts file: router/main.ts, pi/index.ts, <runtime>/features/<name>/..., <runtime>/client/<file>.ts, router/primitives/... or shared/<contract>.ts, with its test beside it. Move it into the row whose job it does.
